_comment: Featured repos for the 'selected work' cards. 'description' overrides the repo's own (empty) description. Stars, forks and language are pulled live from the API.

projects.title: Supreme Court Judgment Analytics
projects.description: Extracts 25 fields from ~1,200 Pakistani Supreme Court judgment PDFs, benchmarks RF / XGBoost / SVM, and ships a dashboard with similar-case search.

projects.title: NN Output Verification
projects.description: SHERLOCK formal verification of a ReLU network predicting CO levels: local search + exact MILP for certified output bounds (R² 0.93).

projects.title: FlyRank ML Internship
projects.description: Ranks pages by under-capture risk over a 79M-row dataset with DuckDB and GroupKFold; four classifiers measured against a frozen baseline.

projects.title: AI Chatbot
projects.description: Flask + Google Gemini chatbot with history, system prompt, Markdown rendering and voice input/output.
